propositions: Commit bodies on main are inconsistent, mixing hard-wrapped (72-79 col) and single-paragraph (129-286 col) styles, with 35 of last 40 commits failing the 50/72 rule

A local commit-msg stage hook must reject commits with subjects over 50 characters or body lines over 72 characters, while exempting trailers, tags, fenced blocks, indented literals, table rows, and atomic tokens (URLs/paths/identifiers)

The hook must chain with Gerrit's existing commit-msg hook (which stamps Change-Id) in migration mode, not clobbering it, and `make hooks` must verify both hook files are present and the Change-Id trailer survives
The checker is check-only and never rewrites messages; it names offending lines by line number and length

Detection rules must match exactly: trailer `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*:\s`, tag `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=`, fence `^\s*``` (toggle), indent 4+ spaces or tab, table row starts `|`, atomic token matches `://|[/\\]|\w[._-]\w` with rest of line <= 72 chars
git scaffolding must produce no false positives: comment lines and the verbose diff below the `>8` marker are ignored
